justification: Five files but no data/query/calculation change: user-facing wording on three surfaces plus one liability regex term mirrored in two places

pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a template elsewhere still says 'as of right', the brief logs a liability warning (scan_liability logs, never drops a line)
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every page render after deploy; the diff-scoped liability check only scans new lines, full grep found no other user-facing occurrence

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_liability_as_of_right.py; python scripts/page_integrity/check.py <fresh captures>/*/
falsifiable_check.fails_when: the scanner stops matching 'as-of-right' prose (test_prose_is_flagged goes red), or the page still renders it (C5 as-of-right > 0)
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Against origin/main's liability_language_check.py the new test file gives '5 failed, 3 passed' (all 4 prose cases + scan_lines red); on this branch 8 passed.

functions.name: scan_lines
functions.input: filepath + list of (line_no, text) from the staged diff
functions.output: list of findings, one per flagged term
functions.if_none: an empty line list returns no findings at all

functions.name: scan_liability
functions.output: list[str] flagged terms, logged as a warning only
functions.if_none: an empty string returns an empty list

values.if_missing: generic form label inside the brackets

break_it.scenario: regex flags the field name as_of_right_form in TSX/Python and blocks unrelated commits
break_it.what_happens: a false liability failure blocks unrelated commits that only touch the field name
break_it.how: scripts/liability_language_check.py FLAGGED_TERMS matches hyphen/space only, never underscore

break_it.scenario: Site Report line containing 'as of right' from DATA (not template) now logs a liability warning
break_it.what_happens: warning in logs; line still shown (scan_liability never drops a line)
break_it.how: services/brief_templates.py:716-722 logs and keeps the line

break_it.scenario: the right of way / rights wording in a real clause matches the new phrase
break_it.what_happens: false liability failure on a quoted clause
break_it.how: regex needs the exact three words as-of-right; tests/test_liability_as_of_right.py checks 'the right of way' passes

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — preview: yield box on an R2 address no longer says as-of-right
